reviews.review: i really like the little characters

Ok, so, I'll start off by saying that I once said to a friend who suggested this game, back when it first released, that I would never play it because it was basically pokemon, and pokemon was for kids, and I am not a kid. Plus, it was an Early Access game, and at that time, my recent experiences with Early access games was that they had almost always been train wrecks...

What can I tell you? Two weeks ago, another friend bought it for their own library, and tried it out, then told me that I would love it be cause of the building and engineering aspect alone, and that I'd grow to like the animals part, and they bought it for me also. 

I accepted the gift, installed it and launched the game, based entirely on their own enthusiasm about it. 

Two weeks later, We've played long into the night on far too many occasions. Sometimes, until just before dawn breaks. I have had so much fun with this game, which is evident by the fact that I have not actually played anything else since installing this!

I've designed and built a primary base that is in a mountainous area, with platforms reaching out over the chasm below. I have created a coal and sulphur mining operation out in a desert area, with the structures perched atop a desert plateau, and an oil well base in a volcanic environment that enables my furtherment of technological research.

Those are the pluses.

The negatives are as follows.

I have neglected my other survival games. 
I have neglected my looter shooter games.
In fact, I've even neglected the phone game I only play while in bed.
In the kitchen, the sink is full of unwashed dishes.
I have not mowed my front lawn.
I have not washed my car.
I have done none of the things I would normally have done, because this game is so good, so much fun!

If you get it too, you will also find yourself spending more time playing it more than anything else you should be doing!

Edited, one month on from my original review.

This game continues to provide something to do. I still have a few rarer pals that I have to complete the 12 bonus XP captures on. I still have to defeat the two final pals(Two of the summoned pals, who are unnecessarily tough!) and my friends and I are now trying to breed the best stats and traits into the pals we are using, both combat types and worker types.

We discovered, in out inhumanity, that capturing an NPC human results in a Steam achievement that records your inhumanity. We then discovered, by joking about feeding human captives with pal fruit. It turns out that humans, once fed with palfruit can learn the same devastating attack moves that all your combat pals can. I do not condone these monstrous acts, but I can tell you that a level 47 PIDF Elite, captured from the Number 3 Wildlife Sanctuary, made to 4 star status and fed all the best palfruits becomes a devastatingly bad-ass companion. Their diminutive stature means they can go anywhere you can go, without having to be recalled and re-deployed like the larget pals have to be. 

This game has made the humans into monsters, and the monsters into the more humane entities. I am not proud of what I have done, but my combat party always includes a PIDF Elite now...

nintendo should not be making lawsuits, they should be making notes! This is how games with balls and fruits and creature taming should be done!
